description: Load a skill's SKILL.md, or one of its linked references, templates or scripts. The first call returns SKILL.md plus a 'linked_files' dict; call again with file_path to read one.
name: skill_view

file_path.description: OPTIONAL: Linked file path (e.g., 'references/api.md', 'templates/config.yaml', 'scripts/validate.py'); the built-in help also supports 'aino-docs/README.md'. Omit to get the main SKILL.md content.

name.description: The skill name (use skills_list to see available skills). For plugin-provided skills, use the qualified form 'plugin:skill'.
